title: Skin Diary Entry Weekly Sleep Hours Trend
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skin:diary sleep_hours=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(sleep_hours) as avg_duration, max(sleep_hours) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst sleep hours for skin diary entry events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture sleep_hours on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average sleep hours with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether skin diary entry tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
